as_told.title: Philadelphia Experiment
as_told.place_text: Philadelphia Navy Yard to Norfolk, Virginia

related.note: Both are about the Philadelphia Experiment. This telling says it really happened in Rhode Island and Philadelphia was the cover story, while the story calls the Philadelphia-to-Norfolk teleportation a bogus disinformation campaign.

plain: The story known as the Philadelphia Experiment holds that, sometime in the 1940s, a Navy ship with its crew still aboard was teleported from a port in Philadelphia to a port in Norfolk, Virginia. Michels tells it himself, and he tells it in two ways. Once he calls it a clearly bogus disinformation campaign and connects it to a man named Thomas Townsend Brown. Another time he simply calls it a rumour and traces it to Bill Moore, Carlos Allende and Morris Jessup and to a book titled The Philadelphia Experiment, without calling it disinformation.
